title: License Check
summary: A trial tool wants a serial you were never given. It carries everything needed to check one.
objectives: Read how the tool checks a serial
Confirm your serial activates the tool
learningOutcomes: Trace a check through its data tables
Explain why client-side checks cannot keep secrets

references.label: CWE-656: Reliance on Security Through Obscurity
MITRE ATT&CK T1027: Obfuscated Files or Information

hints.bodyMd: The comparison needs the right answer in some form, so the answer ships with the tool. Each byte of a serial goes through two steps.
Forwards it is `(byte XOR key) + position`, keeping 8 bits. Undo the steps in the opposite order for each entry in `TABLE`.
